page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor with 8 dedicated vCPUs, 4 physical cores, and a 2.5 GHz clock speed. The instance is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB per core, and includes 472 GB of local SSD storage. For hardware acceleration, it bundles a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Network connectivity is supported by a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In terms of performance, the instance exhibits a clear contrast between CPU-bound tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. Standard CPU benchmarks show limited performance, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core results falling into the poor and weak categories, respectively. Similarly, memory bandwidth and cryptographic operations score in the lower percentiles. However, the integrated NVIDIA P100 GPU delivers strong performance in machine learning tasks. LLM inference benchmarks show top-tier results for prompt processing, achieving 9872.83 tokens per second on a small 135M model and 316.69 tokens per second on a medium 7B model. Text generation speeds are also competitive, reaching 42.77 tokens per second on the 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a specialized hardware profile where the value is concentrated in the bundled GPU and local SSD storage rather than raw CPU compute. It is best suited for workloads that can offload processing to the GPU, such as deep learning inference, model evaluation, and GPU-accelerated data processing, while general-purpose CPU tasks or high-throughput database operations may experience resource bottlenecks.
